text:
Maya (Design): dropping compact-row mocks for the alert/rule editor. two big questions: show channels inline as tiny tokens or use a single 'channels' pill that opens a popover? also where to put suppression wording (inline vs small modal). figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE

Omar (PM): scanability first. dense single-line rows with expandable details please.

Liam (Eng): compact rows are better for perf. stacked cards will slow scroll on 100+ rules. prefer a numeric pill like '3 channels' that lazily loads the list in a popover.

Sasha (Accessibility): a11y notes: when expanding a row keep focus predictable. mark expanded region with aria-labelledby and add an aria-live='polite' region for sample preview updates. popover should have role=dialog/aria-modal=false and trap focus. Escape returns focus to trigger.

Priya (Product): copy: 'suppress until' is vague. recommend 'mute notifications until' if action is for deliveries. add an estimated volume token (low/med/high) next to rule name to help triage.

Maya (Design): noted. I'll iterate with: compact rows + click-to-expand, numeric channels pill -> popover, hidden 'sample settings' chevron for voice (ops/on-call/manager), and replace filled micro-pills with bordered micro-pills for contrast. will post updated frames in this thread.

Liam (Eng): +1. I'll prototype the popover focusing behavior and ensure the channel list mounts lazily.

Sasha (Accessibility): +1 00 Maya 50 please include the aria-live and focus steps in the spec doc.

Priya (Product): :thumbsup:
